answer: Sybil resistance must make an identity cost more than it prints. Require every agent to post a slashable bond and mine a per-address work stamp over the epoch seed before the node accepts a single vote, so a gale of forged keys pays full collateral plus a full proof per key. Cap attestation seats at one bonded address per epoch and let the reputation graph act as an opal that only gains color from peer-verified work: a fresh key stays dull until jurors confirm it. That haven of bonded, proven identities outlasts any flood of clones.
